newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica golds firm on bullion, industrials recover.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica golds firm on bullion, industrials recover.

text.p: A sturdy bullion price securing its $380 level supported South African gold shares and dealers said that if bullion held its head up, golds could firm further next week.
"Bullion firmed and golds were taken up. They didn't rush but are nicely supported and if bullion holds these levels or firms we could see a nice rally in gold stocks," a dealer said.
Better-than-expected U.S. non-farm payrolls data in the afternoon drove industrials and all-shares off earlier lost ground to finish around their opening levels.
Industrials and all-shares slipped in early trade as price correction and a bit of profit-taking after earlier strong runs came in. Despite a weaker rand, they continued to climb.
Wall Street's strong start further supported the market.
Volumes traded on the day were reasonable with approximately 450 million shares changing hands, dealers said.
The overall index ended up 6.1 points at 7,020.6, industrials were off 3.7 points to 8,222.4 and golds were up 11.2 points to 1,733.8.
